description: This file defines several React components related to managing 'masks' within the application, including UI for editing, listing, importing/exporting masks, and associated helper components. It appears to be a central component for mask management in a chat or AI application.

methods.name: reorder
methods.description: Helper function to reorder list items based on drag and drop operations.

methods.name: MaskAvatar
methods.description: React component displaying the avatar for a mask, either a default avatar or a model-based avatar.

methods.name: MaskConfig
methods.description: Component that provides configuration options for a mask, including avatar, name, context sharing, and model settings.

methods.name: ContextPromptItem
methods.description: Component for editing a single prompt in the context list, with drag-and-drop support and delete functionality.

methods.name: ContextPrompts
methods.description: Component managing a list of chat message prompts with drag-and-drop reordering, adding, and removing prompts.

methods.name: MaskPage
methods.description: Main page component for managing masks, including listing, search, import/export, edit, and create functionalities.
